#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    if (w < 4) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    while (m > 0) {
        int remainder = m % w;
        int next = m + 1;
        if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
        m = next / w;
    }
    cout << "YES" << endl;
    return 0;
}
